exposure: levels of hsa-miR-199a-3p/hsa-miR-199b-3p in placenta and first trimester plasma
levels of hsa-miR-3150b-3p in placenta and first trimester plasma
outcome: maternal insulin secretion (Stumvoll first phase index)
cohort: The study participants were pregnant individuals from the Genetics of Glucose regulation in Gestation and Growth (Gen3G) prospective cohort.
finding: Lower maternal insulin secretion was associated with lower levels of hsa-miR-199a-3p/hsa-miR-199b-3p and higher levels of hsa-miR-3150b-3p in both placenta and first trimester plasma.
gest_age: Maternal insulin secretion was estimated at ~26 weeks of gestation; miRNA levels were quantified in first trimester plasma samples and placenta samples collected at delivery.
